cohort_rerun_measured.note: A scoped cohort rerun has run, so the per-source cost is measured rather than interpolated from the full run: USD 1.49 bought 83 named sources out of 143 attempted, i.e. USD 0.0104 per attempted source and USD 0.01795 per named source.

attempt-capped.step: one signed reset with receipts (sn reset), then compose
